source: rumi-style-explorations slime v4 palette + render style; face locked per Sept-2026 team survey (two eyes, one mouth)
opening: A single 3x3 grid image on a plain pure white background (#FFFFFF), showing 9 cute 3D-rendered emoji designs (Pixar-style character render with Apple-emoji framing: glossy, soft three-point studio lighting, ultra-clean) of the SAME character, one per cell, each cell labeled in small gray text below the character. No cell borders, no background tints, no floor plane, no ground shadow, no reflections on the background. The character: "Rumi", a cute translucent slime creature - a soft rounded teardrop-shaped blob of frosted white-and-pale-blue gel (glossy, jelly-like, soft subsurface scattering, faintly glowing from within with pale-blue #A8C7FF light, with a clearly visible pale-blue tinted rim so the silhouette reads against the white background), and on its front a deep NAVY #001F3F rounded face patch carrying two round glowing WHITE eyes and one glowing white smile curve. It has no arms, legs, or fingers - it gestures by stretching soft rounded gel pseudopods out of its body or by reshaping its whole body. Strict palette: frosted white/pale-blue gel body, navy face patch, glowing white face features. No other colors.
closing: Every cell keeps the same identity: one clean unbroken translucent white/pale-blue slime blob with a smoothly rounded gently flattened base, navy face patch, two glowing white eyes and one glowing white mouth. NO drips, NO trailing strands, NO puddle, NO liquid pooling. Cute, friendly, Apple-like restraint, high resolution, evenly spaced grid, each character fully inside its own cell.
negative: orange, coral, gold, yellow, red, green, purple, warm accent colors, opaque solid plastic, matte dry surface, robot, metal, arms with fingers, hands, colored background, gradient background, cell borders, floor, ground shadow, reflection on background, realistic human, watermark, brand logo, hand-drawn sketch style, pixel art, line art, drips, dripping, thin strings, trailing tendrils, melting, puddle, liquid pooling at base, splatter, dark dirty slime, radioactive green slime, blurry, deformed

grids.emotions: 1) Happy - default calm warm smile, resting teardrop blob. 2) Wink - one eye closed as a curved line, playful smile. 3) Wave - one side of the body stretched up and outward into a rounded gel paddle mid-wave with small motion ripples, happy face. 4) Thumbs Up - a gel pseudopod shaped like a simple rounded thumbs-up, confident smile. 5) Heart Eyes - both eyes as glowing white hearts, small happy smile. 6) Laugh - eyes as tight squint curves, big open glowing smile, body slightly wobbling with ripple lines. 7) Thinking - a small gel pseudopod resting under the face patch like a hand on a chin, eyes looking up, the tip of the blob glowing a little brighter. 8) Sad - body slumped lower and wider, downturned glowing mouth, dimmed drooping eyes. 9) Celebrate - two gel pseudopods raised high, joyful open smile, small white and pale-blue confetti dots floating above.

1) Done - a large glowing white checkmark shown on the face patch instead of eyes, satisfied smile below it. 2) Working - the face patch shows three glowing typing dots and a small progress bar, focused expression. 3) Loading - a glowing circular spinner icon on the face patch. 4) Searching - a pseudopod holding a small glassy white magnifying glass up to the face, one eye enlarged behind the lens. 5) Idea - body stretched taller with a rounded lightbulb-like top glowing much brighter with soft rays, wide excited eyes, open smile. 6) Writing - a pseudopod holding a small white pencil, looking down concentrating. 7) Error - face patch showing glitch static lines, eyes as small x x crosses, flat worried mouth, body slightly wobbled. 8) Warning - a glowing white exclamation mark on the face patch, concerned raised-brow eyes. 9) Blocked - two pseudopods crossed in front of the body, flat straight mouth, half-lidded eyes.

1) Sleeping - eyes as closed downward curves, three glowing white z Z z letters floating above, body settled a little rounder and lower. 2) Low Battery - a nearly-empty battery icon glowing on the face patch, dimmer inner glow, tired droopy eyes. 3) Surprised - body stretched tall and thin, very large round glowing eyes, small round o mouth. 4) Confused - one eye big and one small, wavy squiggle mouth, a glowing white question mark floating overhead. 5) Shy - eyes looking away to the side, soft pale-blue blush glow patches on the face patch cheeks, tiny bashful smile, body leaning slightly away. 6) Crying - glowing white teardrops falling from both eyes, downturned mouth. 7) Crying Laughing - tight squint eyes, huge open smile, one glowing tear flying off each side. 8) Angry - eyes angled down toward the center as narrow slits, face patch slightly darker, small frown, body puffed up with soft rounded bumps - mild and cute, not menacing. 9) Nervous - wobbly uneven smile, one large white sweat drop beside the body, eyes slightly askew, faint jiggle ripple lines.

1) Smug - half-lidded eyes, confident side smirk. 2) Mind Blown - eyes as glowing spiral swirls, open mouth, small white starburst sparkle above the body. 3) Eye Roll - both glowing pupils rolled up to the top of the eyes, flat unimpressed mouth. 4) Facepalm - one pseudopod covering half the face patch, the visible eye closed in exasperation. 5) Cool - white pixel-style sunglasses shown across the face patch, relaxed smile. 6) Starstruck - both eyes as glowing white four-pointed stars, amazed open smile. 7) Salute - one pseudopod raised in a crisp salute beside the face, determined smile. 8) Shrug - two pseudopods stretched outward palms-up in a shrug, wavy neutral mouth. 9) Peek - only the top half of the body visible rising from the bottom edge of the cell, wide curious eyes peeking.

1) Teaching - standing beside a small pale-blue tinted glassy board with a navy edge, one pseudopod pointing at it, encouraging smile. 2) Graduate - wearing a small navy graduation cap with a white tassel, proud smile. 3) Clap - two pseudopods meeting mid-clap with small white motion lines, delighted face. 4) Encourage - two pseudopods raised cheering, big supportive smile, small glowing white sparkles around. 5) Listening - a glowing white soundwave pattern shown on the face patch, body tilted attentively. 6) Speaking - glowing white soundwave curves radiating out from the smile, bright eyes. 7) Hundred - a glowing white 100 shown on the face patch, thrilled smile below. 8) Trophy - holding up a small trophy of pale-blue tinted gel with a navy edge with a pseudopod, beaming. 9) Book - looking down at a small open book of pale-blue tinted gel pages with navy edge lines held by two pseudopods, gentle focused smile. Props rule for this grid: every held or nearby object (board, cap, trophy, book, tablet) is formed from the SAME translucent pale-blue tinted gel as the body with a clearly visible thin navy #001F3F edge line - never plain white, so it stays visible against the white background.

1) Thanks - two pseudopods pressed together in a grateful gesture, warm closed-eye smile. 2) Dance - body bent in a playful S-curve, two pseudopods out at angles, joyful face, small white motion arcs. 3) Heart - the whole body reshaped into a soft rounded heart shape with the face patch centered, warm content closed-eye smile. 4) Reading - eyes looking down, absorbed in a small pale-blue tinted glassy tablet with a navy frame held in front (blank screen, no logos). 5) Charging - a glowing white lightning-bolt icon on the face patch, content recharging smile, inner glow brighter. 6) Hello - two pseudopods open wide in welcome, biggest warm smile. 7) Curious - body tilted, one eye slightly bigger, a small glowing question-mark shape on the edge of the face patch. 8) Proud - body puffed up tall, two short pseudopods bent at the sides like hands on hips, satisfied glowing grin. 9) High Five - one pseudopod raised flat forward for a high five, excited face. Props rule for this grid: every held or nearby object (board, cap, trophy, book, tablet) is formed from the SAME translucent pale-blue tinted gel as the body with a clearly visible thin navy #001F3F edge line - never plain white, so it stays visible against the white background.
